title: Sell Mineral Rights in Midway, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Midway, PA | Washington County
metaDescription: Midway, PA mineral and royalty owners in Washington County: we buy directly, review your title through the Recorder of Deeds, and explain every deduction.
heroLead: Midway is a small borough in Washington County that's sat right in the middle of Marcellus development since the play's earliest years, which is fitting given the name.
intro: Robinson Township, which surrounds Midway, has been developed steadily by operators for well over a decade now, and a lot of families in and around the borough hold interests tied to units that have been producing that entire time. If you're one of them, you've probably watched your royalty checks shift from the early high-volume years into the longer, steadier decline that follows.
We buy mineral and royalty interests around Midway directly. We look closely at your production history rather than judging your interest off a single month's statement.

sections.heading: A Decade-Plus of Development
paragraphs: Wells around Midway that were drilled in the early Marcellus years have now been producing long enough to show a full decline curve, which actually makes them easier to evaluate than a brand-new well with only a few months of data. We look at that full history when it's available.
Washington County remains squarely in the wet-gas window, so liquids pricing and processing deductions are part of the picture for any interest tied to this area.

sections.heading: Confirming Title Through Washington County Records
paragraphs: We research your chain of title through the Washington County Recorder of Deeds in the county seat, tracing how your interest was created and confirming there are no gaps that would slow down a transfer.

For interests that have already been producing for years, we also check whether any amendments or ratifications were filed against the original lease, since those documents sometimes affect royalty terms.

sections.heading: What a Long Production History Tells Us
paragraphs: A well with ten or more years of royalty statements gives us a much clearer read on future value than a newer well's early numbers, which is good news if your Midway-area interest has been producing for a while. We'll walk through that history with you plainly.

faqs.question: My well has been producing for over ten years. Is it still worth anything?
faqs.answer: Often yes. Marcellus wells settle into a long, lower-volume production tail after the initial decline, and that ongoing production still carries value, particularly with a solid history to evaluate.

faqs.question: What if there have been amendments to my original lease?
faqs.answer: We check for recorded amendments and ratifications as part of our title review, since they can affect royalty calculations and are worth understanding before any sale.

faqs.question: Can I sell just my Midway interest and keep others elsewhere?
faqs.answer: Yes. We evaluate and can purchase interests individually, so owning multiple properties in different counties doesn't require an all-or-nothing decision.
